summary: Create a dedicated user on each managed node with passwordless sudo via a file in /etc/sudoers.d for containerized AAP to connect as.
questions: How do I prepare managed nodes for containerized AAP?
How do I give the AAP user passwordless sudo?
Which user does AAP connect to managed nodes as?

answer_card.title: Prepare managed nodes
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
sudo adduser <username>
sudo passwd <username>
sudo visudo -f /etc/sudoers.d/<username>
# add:
<username> ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD: ALL
```
